title: This is my…
scenario: Mia and Sam show Smarty their family, including a baby sister.

items.note: Use ‘his’ for something that belongs to a boy or man.
Use ‘her’ for something that belongs to a girl or woman.
Use ‘our’ when something belongs to you and another person together.
A baby is a very small child; more than one is ‘babies’.

image.describe: a tiny baby kitten sleeping in a basket with a soft blanket

items.note: We say ‘parents’ for a mother and a father together.

image.describe: a mother cat and a father cat standing close together and smiling

grammar.title: my, his, her, our
grammar.explanation: Choose the word by who owns it: my is for me, his is for a boy or man, her is for a girl or woman, and our is for me and another person.

practice.prompt: Smarty talks about Sam, a boy. You are not his sister. Complete the sentence.
practice.explanation: Use his for a boy: this is his mother.

practice.prompt: Listen, then choose what you heard.
practice.explanation: Her is for a girl or woman. Listen to the middle word.

practice.prompt: Mia is a girl. Complete the sentence about her.
practice.explanation: Use her for a girl: this is her brother.

practice.prompt: You and Mia talk about your family together. Build the sentence.
practice.explanation: Our shows that the family belongs to both of you.

practice.prompt: Look at the picture of a very small child. Which word fits?
practice.explanation: A baby is a very small child.

practice.prompt: Match the phrases with the same meaning.
practice.explanation: Parents means mother and father together.

practice.prompt: Listen, then choose what you heard.
practice.explanation: Parents is for both mother and father.

practice.prompt: Say the sentence aloud. You can try again.
practice.text: Mum and dad are our parents.
practice.answer: Mum and dad are our parents.
practice.explanation: Our parents means the parents of both of us.

practice.prompt: You and Mia are sisters. Talk about the mother you share. Complete the sentence.
practice.explanation: You share the mother, so use our.

practice.prompt: Lily is a girl. Complete the sentence about her.
practice.explanation: Use her for a girl: her name.

story.hook: Who is the baby in Mia and Sam’s family?

image.describe: Mia and Sam’s living room: Smarty the black cat meets Mia, Sam, their parents and a baby sister sleeping in a basket.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Mum and dad are our parents.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: She is happy. She is our baby!

questions.explanation: Sam says: Her name is Lily.

questions.prompt: Mia says: This is our baby ___.
questions.explanation: Mia says: This is our baby sister.

questions.prompt: Mum and dad are Sam and Mia’s ___.
questions.explanation: Sam says: Mum and dad are our parents.

mission.setup: You show Smarty a picture of your family. Answer in your own words; an imaginary family is fine.

turns.smarty: This is my mother. And you?
turns.hint: Tell Smarty about your mother or your father.

turns.smarty: My mother and father are my parents. Are your parents happy?
turns.hint: Say Yes or No, or say how your parents are.
